_comment: Acquisition manifest — every external source: retrieval URL, exact subset,
expected size, sha256, licence. acquire.py fetches against this file and
exits non-zero on any mismatch. Pipeline modules obtain sources ONLY through
pipeline/sources.require(name); an entry missing here stops the pipeline by
Entries whose subset depends on derived quantities (spectra envelope,
cooling-mass brackets) are pinned in the pass that derives them.
Large files (data/raw/large/) are not committed; retrieval date + sha256 are.

cie_cmf.licence: CVRL public dataset; CIE 1931 standard observer

mist_track_1p0.subset: member 00100M.track.eep only (M=1.0 Msun, [Fe/H]=0, v/vcrit=0.0), extracted to data/raw/mist/00100M.track.eep and committed
mist_track_1p0.licence: MIST v1.2 (Choi et al. 2016, Dotter 2016); free with citation
